No. The data show **81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021**, about **2.23%** of the 3,643.5-hectare property. Another 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event.

Most of the event area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted pine forest. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish whether the land was permanently cleared or harvested for forestry.
